name: Qualify Co-Marketing Partner
summary: Evaluate a joint-marketing partner and define a balanced, measurable campaign agreement.
description: Qualify potential co-marketing partners by audience fit, trust, operational readiness, contribution balance, conflicts, and measurement. Use before proposing a joint campaign, integration launch, webinar, research project, or cross-promotion.
refuses: It does not scrape private contacts, misrepresent an existing relationship, or imply endorsement before agreement.
It does not trade audience data or add contacts to marketing systems without appropriate consent.
It does not recommend a partner solely because of follower count or brand prestige.
